craft_notes: Sthāyin: touching. Sanskrit-first: spṛśan kept. Rows: 2. Close: be. Rejected: detaching — killed: touching shines. Read aloud: shining cadence.

lines: He touches all, yet stands apart.
l4.sanskrit_cite: spṛśanprakāśate yena tataḥ svacchanda ucyate | niyatiṃ karmaphalayorāśrityaiṣa maheśvaraḥ
